mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal ( user_id, goal_type, goal_name, goal_amount, start_amount, goal_date, start_date, goal_status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{goalType}, #{goalName}, #{goalAmount}, #{startAmount}, #{goalDate}, #{startDate}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, goal_name, goal_type, goal_status, goal_amount FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
